subject: Mental Models
title: Natural Selection
description: A fast breakdown of Natural Selection for builders.

hook.text: Darwin noticed finches on different islands had different beaks. The environment shaped each beak over generations.

buildup.text: Natural selection is simple: vary, test, keep what works. Bad fits die out. Good fits survive and multiply.

discovery.text: The same model runs in business. Markets vary products, customers test them, and failures disappear from shelves.

twist.text: Selection has no foresight. It optimizes for right now, not the future. That is why well-adapted species go extinct.

climax.text: Embrace variation and testing in your own life. Try many small experiments and double down on what survives.

punchline.text: Vary, test, keep what works. Evolution in three words.

quiz.question: Why does natural selection sometimes lead to extinction?
options: Selection optimizes for current conditions, not future changes
